desc: The Charles Daly Triple Barrel shotgun are made with the same attention to detail and quality as any of the finest over and under shotgun. It features a three barreled break open, interchangeable choke tubes with Rem choke threads which lets the shooter have multiple pattern options. Fixed fiber optic sights. White receiver/Blued barrel. Rem Choke thread pattern (12 ga and 20 ga only). Break down case included.
